title: The Recipe Improved by One Removed Ingredient
short_teaser: Cooks sometimes simplify a recipe and discover that fewer competing flavors make the central idea clearer.
story: Cooks sometimes simplify a recipe and discover that fewer competing flavors make the central idea clearer. Creative improvement can come from subtraction. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
